layout.task_threads_scope: How many tasks of each kind this server runs at once; the others wait in the queue. Changes apply to the queue at once.
layout.upload_task_threads_num_scope: Uploads sent as tasks, and generating transfer seeds.
layout.offline_download_task_threads_num_scope: Offline downloads fetching into the temporary folder.
layout.offline_download_transfer_task_threads_n: Offline downloads moving their finished files to the target storage.
layout.decompress_upload_task_threads_num_scope: Extracting archives: uploading the extracted files.
layout.speed_limits_scope: Each limit is shared by all the connections of its kind on this server, in KB/s. Empty means no limit.
layout.max_client_download_speed_scope: What clients download from this server: downloads, previews and playback through it, WebDAV and FTP reads.
layout.max_client_upload_speed_scope: What clients upload to this server: web uploads, WebDAV and FTP writes.
layout.max_server_download_speed_scope: What this server reads from storages when it relays a file (proxy, and the SMB, SFTP and FTP storages).
layout.max_server_upload_speed_scope: What this server writes to storages whose drivers honour it.
layout.sync_bandwidth_scope: One limit for all sync jobs together, upload and download. It applies at once, also to running jobs, and is not saved: the server starts again without a limit.
layout.connections_scope: How many download connections a storage opens to one file at once. It belongs to each storage; change it in the storage.
layout.connections_none: No storage here limits its connections per file.

s3_restart_to_apply: Changes to the S3 server take effect after a restart.
s3_buckets_empty: Every bucket needs a name and a path.

about.tagline: A file list program that supports multiple storages
